about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the beginning of Fetish Love: NSFW Dating Sim Demo, a visual novel about student life, romance, and sexual self-discovery.

In the demo version, you will meet the main character — a shy freshman who has just moved to a new city. You will have your first encounters with the heroines: tsundere Rina, dominant Mila, cold intellectual Kira, and playful Sophie.

The demo includes:

🎭 The first story scenes with each heroine.

💖 A sympathy system: your choices and words affect relationships.

🎁 The ability to give gifts and observe unique reactions.

🗺 An interactive city map (home, cafe, park, university).

⏳ Time restrictions: plan your actions.

This demo version is just the beginning. The full game features more explicit scenes, non-linear storylines, secret gifts, and different endings.

content_descriptors.notes:
Game for adults (18+). Romantic comedy with explicit eroticism and fan service.

The demo version will allow you to get acquainted with all the characters in the game. The demo version contains nudity, flirting, and self-gratification in public places with genitals shown.

and occasionally contains profanity and sexual innuendo.

Important: 

All characters are fictional and over the age of 18.

Interactions are based on consent and communication; the game does not contain sexual violence, incest, bestiality, depictions of minors, or sex under the influence of psychoactive substances.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or later
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible graphics card (integrated is fine)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or later
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Dual Core or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 compatible graphics card with 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
